name: Yeah-chop choir lead
desc: Airy human-voice wavetable carries a vowel-morphing E minor line while classic 'yeah' sample chops stutter underneath, re-pitched by speed and sliced by chop. Gospel-garage stutter at peak with sparkle canon.

chop.doc: yeah slice count, bare JS arg

code.sparse: stack(note("<e4 d4 g4 f#4>").struct("[~ x] ~ ~ ~").add(note(${root})).s("wt_hvoice").vowel("<o u>").attack(.05).decay(.4).sustain(.4).release(.2).lpf(${cut}).gain(${gain}*.75).room(.4), s("yeah:2").speed("<1 .75>").struct("~ ~ [~ x] ~").gain(${gain}*.5).hpf(300).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(16))).orbit(5).play()
code.full: stack(note("<[e4 ~ d4 e4] [~ g4 ~ f#4] [g4 ~ a4 ~] [~ b4 ~ f#4]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_hvoice").vowel("<a o e u>").attack(.02).decay(.25).sustain(.3).release(.12).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.2).slow(32)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.35), s("<yeah:2 yeah:7 yeah:11 yeah:2>").speed("<1 1.25 .75 1.5>").struct("[~ x] ~ [~ x] [x ~]").chop(${chop}).gain(${gain}*.55).hpf(250).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)).every(8, rev)).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[e4 d4 e4 g4] [f#4 g4 a4 b4] [g4 a4 b4 d5] [b4 a4 f#4 e4]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_hvoice").vowel("<a e i o u>").attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.25).release(.1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.45, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.3).off(1/4, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.18)), s("yeah:2 yeah:7 yeah:11 yeah:15").speed("<1 1.25 1.5 2>").struct("[x x] [~ x] [x ~] [x x]").chop(${chop}).gain(${gain}*.6).hpf(250).pan(sine.range(.25,.75).slow(8)).degradeBy(.2)).orbit(5).play()
